## About
Los Angeles Electrical Services, Inc. runs ConnectMyWires.com out of Sun Valley. We handle residential, commercial and industrial electrical work across Los Angeles County and Orange County, from panel upgrades and rewiring to lighting, smoke detectors and correcting violations.
We're licensed, insured and bonded, and we offer free job estimates and a lifetime guarantee on all our services. Call with your questions and concerns. We listen first so we understand what you need, then we work hard to get it done.
Our reviews mention Mel by name. We hold a 4.6 rating from 20 Google reviews, and the highest compliment our clients can give us is the referral of their friends, family and business associates.

## Services
- Meter/Panel Upgrades & Servicing: New or upgraded electrical panels and meters, plus servicing for the one you have.
- All Types of Lighting Design & Programmable Lighting Systems: Lighting design and programmable lighting systems, installed and repaired.
- Maintenance & Repair Service Contracts: Ongoing maintenance and repair for properties that need regular electrical care.
- Switches, Receptacles, GFCI Protected, Ceiling/Exhaust Fans & Smoke Detectors: The everyday fixtures around the house, installed and repaired.
- Conversion from Fuses to Breakers: Swapping an old fuse box over to breakers.
- Rewiring & Repairing Old Wiring: Fixing or replacing old wiring in older homes and buildings.
- Pool & Hot Tub Wiring: Wiring for your pool and hot tub.
- Home Safety Inspection: A look through your home's electrical system.

## FAQ
Q: What area do you cover?
A: We serve all of Los Angeles County and Orange County from our shop in Sun Valley.

Q: Do you charge for an estimate?
A: No. Job estimates are free, and all our services come with a lifetime guarantee.

Q: Do you do commercial and industrial work too?
A: Yes. We do residential, commercial and industrial electrical work.

Q: Can I call on a Sunday?
A: Yes. On Sunday we're open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
